items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1961-06-28
items.q: Sam Moran was bass. Sam Moran. Sam Moran. And I was playing guitar with they had two, used two guitars you see.

ctx.x: Yeah. And where was his place?

His place was say a ball, a ballroom you know. And he didn't have much of a dancing space there. About in the Corner of Basin. About in Corner of Basin. items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: I, I, I believe I, I took, I took his place one time

ctx.x: What about Sam Moran? You remember him?

Sam, uh, Sam Moran was a bass player. Now, he played, he played X-ray with Tom Brown at, uh, at Tom Anderson. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. I, I, I believe I, I took, I took his place one time, and I remember the last, the last winding up of, of Tom Anderson, uh, Sam Moran got his, health got bad. And he's living on Gascon Street. And his health got bad, and they had to put me on the bass. Mm-hmm. And I went with Charlie, with Tom Brown. We had Frank Keelan playing trumpet with us then. Yeah. Frank Keelan. Frank Keelan. I'll…
Did they have, uh, two drummers in those times? I mean, before they had the foot pedal, do you remember them? Yeah. Tom Albert told me about it. They always had foot pedals?
